description: Opt-in Codex hook that appends a model-generated suggested next message.

hooks.command:
if [ "${CODEX_SUGGESTED_NEXT_MESSAGE_ENABLED:-0}" != "1" ]; then exit 0; fi
if [ -n "${CODEX_SUGGESTED_NEXT_MESSAGE_COMMAND:-}" ] && [ -f "${CODEX_SUGGESTED_NEXT_MESSAGE_COMMAND}" ]; then exec python3 "${CODEX_SUGGESTED_NEXT_MESSAGE_COMMAND}"; fi
local_hook="${PWD}/.agents/skills/codex-suggested-next-message/scripts/suggest_next_message.py"
user_hook="${HOME}/.agents/skills/codex-suggested-next-message/scripts/suggest_next_message.py"
if [ -f "$local_hook" ]; then exec python3 "$local_hook"; fi
if [ -f "$user_hook" ]; then exec python3 "$user_hook"; fi
exit 0
